title: quercus spicata var. gracilipes
intro: Quercus spicata var. gracilipes, commonly known as Coast Live Oak, is a deciduous tree species native to the Pacific coast of North America. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Quercus spicata var. gracilipes include its ability to act as an anti-diarrheal, antiseptic, and astringent, making it useful in treating digestive issues and wounds. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
